integrity: A theorem proved using published general bounds and the Dimca–Sticlaru characterization; a numerical verifier checks their specializations only. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Complex smooth-conic arrangements with only two A1 nodes and k(k-1)-1 A3 tacnodes for k in {2,3,4}; no extension to other baskets or positive characteristic; no explicit generators claimed. Novelty may be anticipated in unindexed sources.
title: Weak-combinatorial rigidity of minimal plus-one generation at the two-node conic boundary
